scope: Authenticated private Gateway request through real Worker key generation, durable two-role installation, initial signing stock, and client custody verification. Public login and SDK UI are outside this campaign. The additional Gateway campaign uses fresh WebAuthn verification and D1 publication for an existing wallet.

publicSigning.scope: Actual public Gateway routes and advanced SDK client, real WebAuthn, D1 claims, Worker signing, RustCrypto and Node OpenSSL verification. Submission uses a simulated NEAR RPC transport. No on-chain transaction or browser UI is performed.

lifecycle.scope: Production Gateway routes, D1 authority/counter/claim handling, independent signature verification, and real local A/B Worker signing. Recovery and linked-device authorities start at their trusted completed-activation boundary through shared fixture factories. This campaign does not execute recovery-code replacement or QR linking ceremonies.

gateway.scope: Real Gateway routes, fresh P-256 WebAuthn verification, local D1, and prepared Worker key generation. Existing wallet ownership is seeded with shared factories. No ML-DSA-only wallet creation or public transaction-signing route is tested.
